title: No page scrolls sideways
assertion: At 390 px no changed route is wider than the window, every table on it sits in a scroller, and each populated wide table overflows its scroller and shows the caption; at 1280 px, and at 1263 px (1280 less a classic scrollbar), each wide table the tour checks fits its card, every table's headers stand apart, no page scrolls sideways, and a table that fits has no tab stop and no caption, even while a link inside it holds focus
noFileReason: A synthetic practice of its own loads SYNTHETIC CAS-08, CAS-02 and MAP-03, whose files belong to those cases; no file.
